purpose: Records the local workspace and the exact files or ranges the teacher confirmed for this task.
invariants: Listing a file does not mean its contents were read.
Selecting a workspace does not authorize reading every file in it.
Removing an item from the material scope never deletes the local file.
The package must not scan, move, rename, delete, or overwrite local files implicitly.
A permission request must name the narrowest file or folder needed.
